sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS TotalAssets,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN CTR.ContractType = 'Support'
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS SupportContracts,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN CTR.ContractType = 'Maintenance'
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS MaintenanceContracts,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN CTR.ContractType = 'Lease'
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS LeaseContracts,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN CTR.ContractType = 'Warranty'
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS WarrantyContracts,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN CTR.ContractType = 'Software License'
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS SoftwareLicenseContracts,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN CTR.ContractType = 'Master Contract'
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS MasterContracts,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN CTR.`Contract ID+` IS NULL
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS AssetsWithoutContracts

FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE

LEFT OUTER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
    ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.`AssetInstanceId`

LEFT OUTER JOIN `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` CTR
    ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = CTR.CI_Recon_ID

WHERE
    (${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'True' OR ((AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio))
    AND (${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships' OR AP.PersonRole = $Relationship)))
    --AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
        
    AND BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
    )

SELECT
    BE.`Name` AS AssetName,
    BE.`Short Description` AS AssetDescription,
    BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` AS AssetType,
    BE.`Class Id` AS Class,
    BE.`Instance Id`,
    BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AS Instance,
    BE.`Serial Number` AS SerialNumber,
    BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` AS AssetLifecycleStatus,
    BE.`Model Number` AS Product,
    BE.`MarketVersion` AS Version,
    BE.`Reconciliation Identity`,
    BE.Company,
    AP.PersonRole,
    AP.`Full Name`,
    CTR.ContractType,
    CTR.`Contract ID+`,
    CTR.`Expiration Date`,
    CTR.`Notification Date`,
    CTR.Description AS ContractDescription,
    CTR.Status AS ContractStatus,
    CTR.`Cost per Asset.Value` as CostperAsset,
    CTR.instanceId

FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE

INNER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
    ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.`AssetInstanceId`
    INNER JOIN `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` CTR 
       ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = CTR.CI_Recon_ID 

WHERE
     (${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'True' OR AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio))
    AND (${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships' OR AP.`PersonRole` = $Relationship)
    AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
    )

GROUP BY
    BE.`Name`,
    BE.`Short Description`,
    BE.`UserDisplayObjectName`,
    BE.`Class Id`,
    BE.`Instance Id`,
    BE.`Reconciliation Identity`,
    BE.Company,
    BE.`Serial Number`,
    BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus`,
    BE.`Model Number`,
    BE.`MarketVersion`,
    BE.`Reconciliation Identity`,
    AP.PersonRole,
    AP.`Full Name`,
    CTR.ContractType,
    CTR.`Contract ID+`,
    CTR.`Expiration Date`,
    CTR.`Notification Date`,
    CTR.Description ,
    CTR.Status,
    CTR.instanceId,
    CostperAsset

SELECT
    MAX('Support') AS ContractCategory,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` CTR1
                WHERE CTR1.CI_Recon_ID = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND CTR1.ContractType = 'Support'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS Covered,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AST:Contract-CIAssociations` CTR2
                WHERE CTR2.CI_Recon_ID = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND CTR2.ContractType = 'Support'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS NotCovered
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
WHERE
    BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
    )
    AND (
        ${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'true'
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP1
            WHERE AP1.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
              AND AP1.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
              AND (
                  ${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships'
                  OR AP1.`PersonRole` = $Relationship
              )
        )
    )
UNION ALL

SELECT DISTINCT 
          BT_AST_ASSETPEOPLE.`Full Name` AS `FullName`
FROM 
          `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` BT_AST_ASSETPEOPLE
WHERE 
        (
          (
              BT_AST_ASSETPEOPLE.PersonRole  = 'Supported by'
          )
      OR (
              BT_AST_ASSETPEOPLE.PersonRole  = 'Owned by'
          )
      OR (
              BT_AST_ASSETPEOPLE.PersonRole  = 'Managed by'
          )
        )
